thread:
deploy-bot: [deploybot] AUTOMATED: Release lane frozen for 30m due to control-plane errors in us-west-2c. All queued deploys are held. Reason: CP-GLITCH-402.
Samira: seeing spike in control plane error rate, thanks deploy-bot. can we confirm which slots are affected?
deploy-bot: Held slots: release-lane-3 (slots 14-18), canary-group-A, immediate scheduled jobs.
Linus: copying metrics now — control plane API 503s across the region, KV cache miss rate skyrocketed.
Kaya: suggest we pin the next canary to v2026.03.19-hotfix and shift full rollout window by 2 hours. ops-sre, agree?
ops-sre: +1 on pin. we should prevent auto-retries that would requeue and saturate when CP recovers.
Maya: noted. I'll add a note to the release notes draft: "paused due to control-plane instability; will reschedule window after ops validation."
Samira: quick decision: can we soft-rollback the canary that started 3m ago? it's still within ramp.
Linus: canary traffic is ~2%. if we rollback now it's safe, but we need a rollback checklist.
Kaya: rollback checklist (short): 1) pin traffic to previous variant 2026.03.12-stable; 2) invalidate kvcache prefixes for canary keys; 3) monitor error rate for 15m.
Samira: ok doing step 1 now — command: 
```bash
deployctl set-pin --lane release-lane-3 --version 2026.03.12-stable --who Samira
```
deploy-bot: Pin applied by Samira to release-lane-3 -> 2026.03.12-stable. Auto-requeue of pinned slots disabled.
ops-sre: I'll pause any auto-schedulers that would spin up reserved machines; avoiding extra load.
Maya: I'll update the release notes and add a prominent "Hold due to CP incident" header so stakeholders know.
Kaya: postmortem action: add a safety gate to prevent canary rollouts during CP error > 2% for 10m. filing ticket INF-3121.
Linus: re: reschedule: propose shifting the lane to start at 1712517600 (approx +2h) and run canary-only for first 30m. anyone object?
Samira: no objections. schedule that and note tenant-facing downtime = none.
deploy-bot: Scheduled reschedule: release-lane-3 -> start 1712517600, canary window 30m. Operators: execute manual resume after ops-sre confirms CP stable.
ops-sre: will validate CP health and post "ops-sre: CP ok" in this thread before manual resume.
Maya: also tagging product and support channels with the hold + reschedule ETA.
Samira: thanks all — keeping this short. once ops-sre gives ok we'll proceed with the pinned rollout plan.
ops-sre: CP health check in progress, ETA 12m. monitoring dashboards: https://dash.redwood.internal/cp/us-west-2c
Linus: logging this thread in the release ticket and adding the rollback ops notes.
Maya: done — release notes updated and link added to ticket.
ops-sre: CP ok. error rate back to baseline for 18m. manual resume allowed.
Samira: resuming per checklist in 2m. will watch metrics and be ready to abort.
deploy-bot: Resume requested by Samira. Please confirm: resume now? (type `confirm resume` to proceed)
Kaya: confirm resume
deploy-bot: Resuming rollout for release-lane-3. Canary traffic -> 2% for 30m. Monitoring channels: #slo-alerts, #ingest-metrics.
Maya: marking release notes: "Resumed after control-plane recovery. Canary pinned to stable before resume."
Samira: monitoring — all green so far. closing the hold.
Maya: following up: will add a short blameless incident note and link INF-3121 for the safety gate work.
Linus: good call on pinning. saves us a cascade on recovery.
ops-sre: closing ops check, will follow up in postmortem.
